parameters.site_description: Executable contracts for coherent repository foundations and public site surfaces.

product.name: Holon
product.description: A deterministic repository and site-foundation materializer.

documentation.title: Holon documentation
documentation.introduction: Use versioned manifests to resolve capabilities, review a filesystem plan, and materialize only accepted outputs.

pages.title: Materialization lifecycle
pages.summary: Plan, render, verify, and roll back generated ownership explicitly.
pages.body: A plan is timestamp-free and content-addressed. Rendering recomputes that plan before mutation, verification checks every managed digest, and rollback refuses to erase later human edits.

pages.title: Site profiles
pages.summary: Select generic React, LaunchKit, and Zensical surfaces without template forks.
pages.body: The generic React/Vite foundation remains independently useful. LaunchKit is an optional developer-product landing profile, while Zensical renders durable documentation, architecture, and legal content.

architecture.title: Holon site architecture
architecture.introduction: Composition keeps source ownership separate from local materialization and publication.
architecture.diagram:
flowchart TD
  intent[Repository manifest] --> holon[Holon materialization]
  holon --> landing[Landing]
  holon --> docs[Zensical surfaces]
  landing --> relay[Relay artifact]
  docs --> relay

decisions.title: Keep React and Vite generic
decisions.summary: The application foundation cannot depend on a marketing-page information architecture.

decisions.title: Compose LaunchKit as an overlay
decisions.summary: The developer-tool landing profile remains selectable and independently versioned.

legal.title: Holon legal and trust
legal.introduction: These routes project reviewed policy content; they do not become its canonical source.

pages.title: License
pages.summary: Holon is distributed under the MIT License.
pages.body: Read the canonical license in the repository before redistributing Holon or generated materials.

pages.title: Accessibility
pages.summary: Public surfaces are static-first, keyboard reachable, and reduced-motion aware.
pages.body: Report accessibility defects through the repository issue tracker so the shared blueprint and affected consumers can be reconciled.
